# ft6336u

Thingstudio's own driver for the FocalTech FT6336U capacitive touch controller (also fine for FT6236/FT6206),
written 2026-10-08 for the Freenove ESP32-S3 Display 4.0" (I2C address 0x38). One touch point, as pixels.
Licence: Apache-2.0, same as the rest of Thingstudio. Written from the datasheet's register map; no vendored code.
